definitions.short: to prostrate ; by implication, to overthrow , decay
definitions.full: H2522. chalash [ חָלַשׁ ] verb 1. be weak, prostrate . 2 (si vera lectio) weaken, disable, prostrate (Aramaic חֲלַשׁ be weak ; , חַלָּשׁ weak , as in Hebrew; Arabic poor (Frey)) — Qal Imperfect וַיַּחֲלשׁ Exod 17:13 , וַיֶּחֱלָ֑שׁ Job 14:10 ; Participle חוֺלֵשׁ Isa 14:12 ; 1 ויח ימות ׳וגבר Job 14:10 but man dieth and is prostrate. 2 disable, prostrate , followed by accusative of person Exod 17:13 (E; point as Hiph`il ?); followed by עַל person (strangely) Isa 14:12 .
